Education and research sectors. Utilization as equipment for education and research in universities, public research institutions, and general laboratories. Food 3D printers are used in food education institutions and food research institutions.

Food and hospitality industries. Utilization of food 3D printers for personalized cuisine, mass production for large-scale catering businesses, and the creation of health and special foods (low-sugar, allergen-free alternatives). Applicable across various food service sectors, including restaurants, cafes, hotels, experiential museums, and kids' cafes.

Advertising and signage industry. Maximization of commercial space and brand value through high-quality channel signs produced using 3D printing methods. This includes the efficiency of high-quality sign production using 3D printing technology. Capability to produce customized design signs for small shops to large franchises, contributing to brand value maximization.

Public institutions and financial institutions. Contribution to customer ID verification and infection prevention through non-contact ID scanner solutions. Protection of students and staff through school access control kiosks.

Development of proprietary "Shine UV" resin technology. This demonstrates innovative technological development capabilities driving innovation in the signage industry.
